ico.title: IČO
ico.description: IČO of the publishing authority or of any counterparty. Leading zeros optional.

name.title: Party name contains
name.description: Case-insensitive substring of the authority or a counterparty name.

keywords.title: Subject keywords
keywords.description: Contract subject must contain at least one (case-insensitive), e.g. 'kampaň', 'software', 'tablet'.

dateFrom.title: Published from
dateFrom.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days before 'Published to'. Registry starts 2016-07-01.

onlyValid.title: Only valid records
onlyValid.description: Skip records the authority has invalidated.

limit.title: Max contracts
limit.description: You pay per contract returned; the run stops at this number.
